facts.fact: The e-Government Agency issued the e-Government Architecture Vision - Standards and Technical Guidelines (eGA/EXT/AVS/001) v1.0, approved by its CEO in November 2017, as the first of nine e-Government enterprise architecture areas, which include an interoperability framework and apply to all public institutions.

claims.gtmi-dacc703a77: The World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) lists the e-Government Architecture Vision Standard Technical Guides (2017) and the primary confirms it, recorded as the standing fact.
